newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso closes higher at 1,030.80 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso closes higher at 1,030.80 per dollar.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed higher for the second straight session after ending at a seven-month high Tuesday on what interbank dealers described as shrinking demand for dollars.
Dealers said the peso, which traded in a 1,027.50 to 1,034.40 per dollar range, closed at 1,030.80, up 1.7 pesos from Tuesday's close.

"The (dollar) rate keeps coming down and there's no stopping it," a dealer said in a telephone interview. "We'd thought there would be some resistance at 1,030 but it doesn't look like there's enough demand (for dollars) to stop the fall."
Dealers said fresh dollar sales by coffee and oil exporters contributed to the peso's gain, even though no large amounts were involved.
"The volumes weren't big, but when there's no demand any supply knocks down the (dollar) rate," one said.
Dealers reported an above-average 344 trades for a total of $133 million.
